recipe.prompt:
A clean, publication-quality scientific flowchart showing a six-stage horizontal Reviewer/Rebuttal Workflow for evidence-governed peer review. Left side shows INPUT: Manuscript + Reviewer Concerns flowing into six connected stage boxes with arrows between them: (1) Claim Extraction - parsing manuscript into structured claims, (2) Evidence Linking - mapping claims to evidence via figures/tables/methods/provenance, (3) Fragility Audit - classifying claims as supported/fragile/unsupported/needs_narrowing/needs_experiment, (4) Reviewer Decomposition - decomposing concerns into atomic comments mapped to claims, (5) Rebuttal & Revision Planning - prioritized response matrix and claim-edit plans, (6) Response Generation - drafting response letters and polishing plan. Right side shows OUTPUT: Claim-Evidence Revision Package + Response-Letter Draft + Decision Log. Professional blue and teal color palette, clean modern sans-serif typography, polished rounded stage boxes with subtle shadows, logical rightward flow arrows, white background. Academic computer science paper figure style. No pixel art, no clutter.

SciForge semantic visual brief:
- Treat any upstream scientific_plotting or diagram draft as structure only; create the polished final visual, not a tiny box draft.
- Use a full-canvas composition with clear hierarchy, large readable labels, grouped modules, directional arrows, and visual emphasis on the key scientific/technical relationships.
- Prefer a publication-grade schematic style: clean typography, balanced spacing, subtle color coding, light background, and concise annotations.
- Fill the canvas with meaningful content while preserving the requested scientific semantics; avoid sparse center-only layouts, overlapping labels, illegible microtext, and generic placeholder blocks.
- For model architecture or workflow figures, show inputs, core stages, outputs, side effects/context, and feedback/control loops when relevant.
- Style preset: scientific-diagram.
- Output: one self-contained high-resolution PNG-style figure suitable for VisualDocument review.
